title: Structured orthogonal and unitary matrices: factorization, geometry and singularities
abstract: Block-diagonal matrix factors interleaved with fixed coordinate permutations define low-parametric matrix families. This formalization proves orthogonal-factor sufficiency for two and three real layers, its complex unitary analogue, and explicit four-layer counterexamples over both fields. It establishes an exact two-factor cell-rank criterion and real and unitary cosine-sine exhaustion for the (p,2,p) shuffle family. Two-layer images with complete within-layer block sharing, arbitrary overlap and arbitrary fixed carriers have a smooth atlas in the inherited matrix topology, an exact tangent image, a smooth Frobenius projector, a whole-tangent-bundle Cayley retraction and smooth intrinsic gradient sections. Shared orthogonal block exponential curves have normal ambient acceleration and constant Frobenius speed under the no-off-diagonal-overlap condition. Three-layer (2,q,2) families have genuine topological singularities for every real q >= 3 and for odd unitary q >= 3. The full supported proof library is included; experimental special-unitary drafts and the explicitly listed remaining problems are not claimed.

mathematical_sources.title: Riemannian Structure and Optimization for a Class of Low-Parametric Orthogonal Matrices
